title: Atelier Gapette — configuration v3
description: Manufacturing choices for one cap (v3: curvature, rotation, 12 fonts, size 30–250 %). Validated identically by assets/src/schema.js and includes/class-ag-schema.php. v1 documents are accepted and converted (curve 100, rotation 0). Any unknown key is rejected.

renderer_version.description: decal-6 (0.11.1): positions in millimetres on the flat visor; for the underside, mirrored frame (outer edge at the top, read with the visor up). decal-1 to decal-5 documents are converted on load.

texts.description: 1 to 3 texts. With several texts, no empty value. A text may slightly overhang the visor edge (4 mm at most): the part outside the visor is not printed.

value.description: 24 graphemes max, spaces included. Character set: A–Z a–z 0–9, Latin accented letters (À–ÿ, Œ œ), space and . , ' ’ ! ? & : ; ( ) / + # @ * " « » … € -. Never HTML.

side.description: Top or underside of the visor

size_percent.description: Size actually rendered: reduced automatically if the text does not fit on the visor (e.g. along the axis).

curve.description: Curvature: 100 = follows the visor curve, 0 = straight, negative = reversed arc.

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees in the visor plane: 0 = parallel to the edge, -90 = along the axis (reading from the visor towards the crown, bottom to top), +90 = along the axis the other way.

position.description: Millimetres on the flat visor (decal-6): origin at mid-depth on the centre line, x to the right; top: y from the seam (−) to the outer edge (+); underside: mirrored frame, y from the outer edge (−) to the seam (+). Valento Summit visor, 155 × 55 mm. The engine also clamps the position to keep it on the visor.

image.description: Reserved: {asset_id, sha256, crop, source_dimensions} object for when photo upload is opened to orders (private uploads).
